original_goals.annual_return: Each included natural year: if original executable buyhold>0, strategy>=1.5*buyhold; otherwise strategy>0
original_goals.annual_drawdown: Each included natural year strictly below original executable buyhold drawdown
original_goals.partial2026: Retain actual original Jan1..Oct15 annual return/drawdown test, do not annualize or project yearend
original_goals.frequency: Original fullwindow actual funded closed cycles/sessions*60>=3; planned slots do not count
original_goals.no_new_hard_gate: Do not add mandatory per-year no-harm versus C9461, concentration/CI/samplecount vetoes. Report all original2020-26 goals and complete2020-25 contrast together.

competition_checks.alternative_explanation: A full no-pause cost policy is already observed and also misses the2026 original return goal. Differences include pre2026 wealth and earlier participation/feedback, so the two annual returns cannot isolate a same-year pause causal share.
competition_checks.needed_evidence: Actual2026 consumed slots, inherited reservations, failed BUYs and subsequent actual entries; distinguish first state divergence from first target and funded divergence. No hypothetical future fill test at the skipped D.

competition_checks.apparent_repair: Capture the rise that occurred while flat
competition_checks.alternative_explanation: Flat positive-price days are an ex-post opportunity-cost description. They may fall inside original reservations, failed limit BUYs, no qualifying entry, or a deliberately consumed slot. End-of-day price advance is not proof of a D-known predictive entry state or feasible execution.
competition_checks.needed_evidence: Partition actual flat periods by contemporaneous D decision cause before proposing an action. Keep account daily E price/wealth and previous-D known state separate; no future high, fill status or end-of-cycle gain may become a feature.

competition_checks.apparent_repair: Hold longer after profitable exit or ignore a loss exit
competition_checks.alternative_explanation: More exposure may capture upside but also incur larger drawdown, costs and missed later entry opportunities; it can alter inherited pending and reservation paths. Ex-post rally after exit does not identify a safe continuation state.
competition_checks.needed_evidence: Actual exit reason and priority at D, eligible discretionary population versus deadline/inherited pending, actual next-E exit price, and later participation. Compare complete financed paths, never sum saved missed-rally returns or independent local action gains.

competition_checks.apparent_repair: Use annual cash PnL or a capture ratio to explain underperformance
competition_checks.alternative_explanation: Own year-opening equity is the annual denominator. Different prehistory capital explains currency amounts, not by itself a percentage-point failure against the fixed goal. Lot/cash residuals and crossyear inventory can change normalized exposure, and must be shown rather than attributed to denominator alone.
competition_checks.needed_evidence: Use each policy's own actual year-opening equity, inherited position/cash, year-end marked open inventory, real both-side costs and exact executable buyhold; no year reset or forced cutoff liquidation.

competition_checks.apparent_repair: Reduce exits, remove protection, or change the entry clock
competition_checks.alternative_explanation: An apparent improvement could be generic higher risk exposure or a different phase of participation, not the intended state information. A tighter target gap alone does not certify original DD/frequency or prior six annual goals.
competition_checks.needed_evidence: Retain all original2020-26 metrics and the six complete-year table. For a successor, change one identified action responsibility while keeping fixed contract and numeric thresholds; do not encode year/date or scan nearby Z/ATR/pause lengths.

competition_checks.apparent_repair: An apparent last slot or last exit would profit after cutoff
competition_checks.alternative_explanation: Original2026-10-15 is a hard evidence boundary. A planned slot may legitimately extend past cutoff; there is no authorized later fill or realized payoff to impute.
competition_checks.needed_evidence: Keep pending/armed/reservation/censored state explicit. Mark known open inventory at actual cutoff under original valuation; do not invent postcutoff sessions, prices, fills, closure or annualization.

All2020-26 actual accounts remain correlated seen-history diagnostic evidence; improved history is not an independent future-signal proof.
